comments.body: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5543 - figure out if we want to merge this in and test it on devnet 8. Consensus breaking change.
I would like to give a quick update on the status of compliance tests for Gloas

I would like to ask about the safety decay parameter for historical block retention on the CL and also the default flags that clients are using.

This was brought up on the ETH R&D discord in the history-expiry channel [here](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/953349957400821860/1538274653020360856) and [here](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/953349957400821860/1538284049787785346)
In EL breakout, I want to bring up EIP-7610 and how to test it, cc @rakita @rjl493456442 (also in context of EIP-8253)

I'd like to discuss @potuz's open PR about allowing epoch boundary reorgs in Gloas:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5492
gmgm 🫡 I'd like to bring up the EthpandaOps Contributoor program (https://ethpandaops.io/contribute-data/) e.g. re: registration, data collection goals etc.
